blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Several performers collapsed due to extreme heat during the Diyandi Festival here on Sunday, held in celebration of the city’s patronal fiesta in honor of Saint Michael the Archangel. Six contingents joined the Kasadya Street Dancing and Showdown Competition at the Anahaw Amphitheater. READ: Diyandi Festival toasts cultural harmony in Iligan Rio Jimenez, deputy head for operations of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), said extreme heat exhausted an undetermined number of performers and audience members. He said at least 10 members of each contingent were immediately given first aid after their performances. Three individuals […]...
